title: Compactification
description: Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

puzzle.goal: A massless field lives in five dimensions, one of which is curled into a circle of radius R. Its momentum around the circle can only take whole-number values n of ħ/R. Seen from four dimensions, write the energy of each mode with ordinary momentum p, including a rest mass m it may also have.
puzzle.name: Kaluza–Klein mass tower
puzzle.ask: For a massless field at rest, the n-th mode has E = nħc/R. Find the first excitation in GeV for the radius below.
puzzle.method: Periodicity around the circle quantises the extra momentum component; the five-dimensional energy-momentum relation then looks like a mass in four dimensions.
